vsm2.12:69.1: Āvibhāvaṃ tirobhāvanti ettha āvibhāvaṃ karoti tirobhāvaṃ karotīti ayamattho.
vsm2.12:69.2: Idameva hi sandhāya paṭisambhidāyaṃ vuttaṃ ‘‘āvibhāvanti kenaci anāvaṭaṃ hoti appaṭicchannaṃ vivaṭaṃ pākaṭaṃ. Tirobhāvanti kenaci āvaṭaṃ hoti paṭicchannaṃ pihitaṃ paṭikujjita’’nti (paṭi. ma. 3.11).
vsm2.12:69.3: Tatrāyaṃ iddhimā āvibhāvaṃ kātukāmo andhakāraṃ vā ālokaṃ karoti, paṭicchannaṃ vā vivaṭaṃ, anāpāthaṃ vā āpāthaṃ karoti.
vsm2.12:70.2: Ayañhi yathā paṭicchannopi dūre ṭhitopi vā dissati, evaṃ attānaṃ vā paraṃ vā kātukāmo pādakajjhānato vuṭṭhāya idaṃ andhakāraṭṭhānaṃ ālokajātaṃ hotūti vā, idaṃ paṭicchannaṃ vivaṭaṃ hotūti vā, idaṃ anāpāthaṃ āpāthaṃ hotūti vā āvajjitvā
vsm2.12:70.5: Pare dūre ṭhitāpi passanti. Sayampi passitukāmo passati.
vsm2.12:71.3: Bhagavā hi cūḷasubhaddāya nimantito vissakammunā nimmitehi pañcahi kūṭāgārasatehi sāvatthito sattayojanabbhantaraṃ sāketaṃ gacchanto yathā sāketanagaravāsino sāvatthivāsike, sāvatthivāsino ca sāketavāsike passanti, evaṃ adhiṭṭhāsi.
vsm2.12:71.4: Nagaramajjhe ca otaritvā pathaviṃ dvidhā bhinditvā yāva avīciṃ ākāsañca dvidhā viyūhitvā yāva brahmalokaṃ dassesi.
vsm2.12:72.2: Bhagavā kira yamakapāṭihāriyaṃ katvā caturāsītipāṇasahassāni bandhanā pamocetvā atītā buddhā yamakapāṭihāriyāvasāne kuhiṃ gatāti āvajjitvā
vsm2.12:72.4: Athekena pādena pathavītalaṃ akkamitvā dutiyaṃ yugandharapabbate patiṭṭhapetvā
vsm2.12:72.6: tattha paṇḍukambalasilātale vassaṃ upagantvā sannipatitānaṃ dasasahassacakkavāḷadevatānaṃ ādito paṭṭhāya abhidhammakathaṃ ārabhi.
vsm2.12:72.7: Bhikkhācāravelāya nimmitabuddhaṃ māpesi. So dhammaṃ deseti.
vsm2.12:73.1: Bhagavā nāgalatādantakaṭṭhaṃ khāditvā anotattadahe mukhaṃ dhovitvā uttarakurūsu piṇḍapātaṃ gahetvā anotattadahatīre paribhuñjati.
vsm2.12:73.3: Bhagavā ajja ettakaṃ dhammaṃ desesinti therassa nayaṃ deti.
vsm2.12:73.4: Evaṃ tayo māse abbocchinnaṃ abhidhammakathaṃ kathesi.
vsm2.12:74.2: bhagavantaṃ passitvāva gamissāmāti khandhāvāraṃ bandhitvā aṭṭhāsi.
vsm2.12:74.4: Manussā kuhiṃ bhagavāti jānanatthāya anuruddhattheraṃ yāciṃsu.
vsm2.12:74.5: Thero ālokaṃ vaḍḍhetvā addasa dibbena cakkhunā tattha vassūpagataṃ bhagavantaṃ disvā
vsm2.12:75.3: sinerupabbataṃ nibbijjhitvā tathāgatapādamūle bhagavato pāde vandamānova ummujjitvā
vsm2.12:75.4: bhagavantaṃ etadavoca ‘‘jambudīpavāsino, bhante, bhagavato pāde vanditvā passitvāva gamissāmāti vadantī’’ti.
vsm2.12:75.5: Bhagavā āha ‘‘kuhiṃ pana te, moggallāna, etarahi jeṭṭhabhātā dhammasenāpatī’’ti?
vsm2.12:75.7: ‘‘Moggallāna, maṃ daṭṭhukāmā sve saṅkassanagaraṃ āgacchantu, ahaṃ sve mahāpavāraṇapuṇṇamāsīuposathadivase saṅkassanagare otarissāmī’’ti.
vsm2.12:76.1: ‘‘Sādhu, bhante’’ti thero dasabalaṃ vanditvā āgatamaggeneva oruyha manussānaṃ santikaṃ sampāpuṇi.
vsm2.12:76.2: Gamanāgamanakāle ca yathā naṃ manussā passanti, evaṃ adhiṭṭhāsi.
vsm2.12:76.4: So evaṃ āgato taṃ pavattiṃ ārocetvā ‘‘dūranti saññaṃ akatvā katapātarāsāva nikkhamathā’’ti āha.
vsm2.12:77.1: Bhagavā sakkassa devarañño ārocesi ‘‘mahārāja, sve manussalokaṃ gacchāmī’’ti.
vsm2.12:77.2: Devarājā vissakammaṃ āṇāpesi ‘‘tāta, sve bhagavā manussalokaṃ gantukāmo, tisso sopānapantiyo māpehi ekaṃ kanakamayaṃ, ekaṃ rajatamayaṃ, ekaṃ maṇimaya’’nti.
vsm2.12:78.1: Bhagavā dutiyadivase sinerumuddhani ṭhatvā puratthimalokadhātuṃ olokesi,
vsm2.12:78.2: anekāni cakkavāḷasahassāni vivaṭāni hutvā ekaṅgaṇaṃ viya pakāsiṃsu.
vsm2.12:78.3: Yathā ca puratthimena, evaṃ pacchimenapi uttarenapi dakkhiṇenapi sabbaṃ vivaṭamaddasa.
vsm2.12:78.4: Heṭṭhāpi yāva avīci, upari yāva akaniṭṭhabhavanaṃ, tāva addasa.
vsm2.12:79.1: Taṃ divasaṃ kira lokavivaraṇaṃ nāma ahosi. Manussāpi deve passanti, devāpi manusse. Tattha neva manussā uddhaṃ ullokenti, na devā adho olokenti, sabbe sammukhāva aññamaññaṃ passanti. Bhagavā majjhe maṇimayena sopānena otarati, chakāmāvacaradevā vāmapasse kanakamayena, suddhāvāsā ca mahābrahmā ca dakkhiṇapasse rajatamayena.
vsm2.12:79.5: pañcasikho gandhabbaputto tigāvutamattaṃ beḷuvapaṇḍuvīṇaṃ gahetvā tathāgatassa pūjaṃ karonto otarati.
vsm2.12:79.6: Taṃdivasaṃ bhagavantaṃ disvā buddhabhāvāya pihaṃ anuppādetvā ṭhitasatto nāma natthi.
vsm2.12:80.1: Apica tambapaṇṇidīpe talaṅgaravāsī dhammadinnattheropi tissamahāvihāre cetiyaṅgaṇasmiṃ nisīditvā ‘‘tīhi, bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu apaṇṇakapaṭipadaṃ paṭipanno hotī’’ti apaṇṇakasuttaṃ (a. ni. 3.16) kathento heṭṭhāmukhaṃ bījaniṃ akāsi, yāva avīcito ekaṅgaṇaṃ ahosi.
vsm2.12:80.2: Tato uparimukhaṃ akāsi, yāva brahmalokā ekaṅgaṇaṃ ahosi.
vsm2.12:80.3: Thero nirayabhayena tajjetvā saggasukhena ca palobhetvā dhammaṃ desesi.
vsm2.12:80.4: Keci sotāpannā ahesuṃ, keci sakadāgāmī anāgāmī arahantoti.
vsm2.12:81.1: Tirobhāvaṃ kātukāmo pana ālokaṃ vā andhakāraṃ karoti, appaṭicchannaṃ vā paṭicchannaṃ, āpāthaṃ vā anāpāthaṃ karoti.
vsm2.12:81.3: Ayañhi yathā appaṭicchannopi samīpe ṭhitopi vā na dissati, evaṃ attānaṃ vā paraṃ vā kātukāmo pādakajjhānato vuṭṭhāya ‘‘idaṃ ālokaṭṭhānaṃ andhakāraṃ hotū’’ti vā, ‘‘idaṃ appaṭicchannaṃ paṭicchannaṃ hotū’’ti vā, ‘‘idaṃ āpāthaṃ anāpāthaṃ hotū’’ti vā āvajjitvā
vsm2.12:82.3: Bhagavā hi yasaṃ kulaputtaṃ samīpe nisinnaṃyeva yathā naṃ pitā na passati, evamakāsi.
vsm2.12:82.4: Tathā vīsayojanasataṃ mahākappinassa paccuggamanaṃ katvā taṃ anāgāmiphale, amaccasahassañcassa sotāpattiphale patiṭṭhāpetvā,
vsm2.12:82.5: tassa anumaggaṃ āgatā sahassitthiparivārā anojādevī āgantvā samīpe nisinnāpi yathā saparisaṃ rājānaṃ na passati, tathā katvā
vsm2.12:82.7: ‘‘kiṃ pana te rājānaṃ gavesituṃ varaṃ, udāhu attāna’’nti?
vsm2.12:82.9: tathā dhammaṃ desesi, yathā sā saddhiṃ itthisahassena sotāpattiphale patiṭṭhāsi, amaccā anāgāmiphale, rājā arahatteti.
vsm2.12:83.1: Apica tambapaṇṇidīpaṃ āgatadivase yathā attanā saddhiṃ āgate avasese rājā na passati, evaṃ karontena mahindattherenāpi idaṃ katameva (pārā. aṭṭha. 1.tatiyasaṅgītikathā).
vsm2.12:84.1: Apica sabbampi pākaṭaṃ pāṭihāriyaṃ āvibhāvaṃ nāma.
vsm2.12:84.6: Uparimakāyato aggikkhandho pavattati, heṭṭhimakāyato udakadhārā pavattatī’’ti (paṭi. ma. 1.116) evaṃ ubhayaṃ paññāyittha.
vsm2.12:84.8: Taṃ mahakasuttena (saṃ. ni. 4.346) ca brahmanimantanikasuttena (ma. ni. 1.501 ādayo) ca dīpetabbaṃ.
vsm2.12:84.9: Tatra hi āyasmato ca mahakassa, bhagavato ca iddhiyeva paññāyittha, na iddhimā.
vsm2.12:85.1: ‘‘Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho citto gahapati āyasmantaṃ mahakaṃ etadavoca
vsm2.12:85.2: ‘sādhu me, bhante, ayyo mahako uttarimanussadhammā iddhipāṭihāriyaṃ dassetū’ti.
vsm2.12:85.3: Tena hi tvaṃ gahapati āḷinde uttarāsaṅgaṃ paññāpetvā tiṇakalāpaṃ okāsehīti.
vsm2.12:85.4: ‘Evaṃ, bhante’ti kho citto gahapati āyasmato mahakassa paṭissutvā āḷinde uttarāsaṅgaṃ paññāpetvā tiṇakalāpaṃ okāsesi.
vsm2.12:85.5: Atha kho āyasmā mahako vihāraṃ pavisitvā tathārūpaṃ iddhābhisaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkhāsi,
vsm2.12:85.6: yathā tālacchiggaḷena ca aggaḷantarikāya ca acci nikkhamitvā tiṇāni jhāpesi, uttarāsaṅgaṃ na jhāpesī’’ti (saṃ. ni. 4.346).
vsm2.12:86.3: ‘ettāvatā brahmā ca brahmaparisā ca brahmapārisajjā ca saddañca me sossanti, na ca maṃ dakkhissantī’ti antarahito
vsm2.12:86.5: ‘Bhave vāhaṃ bhayaṃ disvā, bhavañca vibhavesinaṃ; Bhavaṃ nābhivadiṃ kiñci, nandiñca na upādiyi’’’nti. (ma. ni. 1.504);
vsm2.12:87.1: Tirokuṭṭaṃ tiropākāraṃ tiropabbataṃ asajjamāno gacchati seyyathāpi ākāseti
vsm2.12:87.2: ettha tirokuṭṭanti parakuṭṭaṃ, kuṭṭassa parabhāganti vuttaṃ hoti.
vsm2.12:88.1: Evaṃ gantukāmena pana ākāsakasiṇaṃ samāpajjitvā vuṭṭhāya
vsm2.12:88.2: kuṭṭaṃ vā pākāraṃ vā sinerucakkavāḷesupi aññataraṃ pabbataṃ vā āvajjitvā kataparikammena
vsm2.12:88.5: Adho otaritukāmassa, uddhaṃ vā ārohitukāmassa susiro hoti,
vsm2.12:89.3: kiṃ hatthiassādīni abhinimminitukāmo hatthiassādi kasiṇāni samāpajjati,
vsm2.12:89.4: nanu yattha katthaci kasiṇe parikammaṃ katvā aṭṭhasamāpattivasībhāvoyeva pamāṇaṃ.
vsm2.12:89.5: Yaṃ yaṃ icchati, taṃ tadeva hotī’’ti.
vsm2.12:89.7: ‘‘pāḷiyā, bhante, ākāsakasiṇaṃyeva āgataṃ, tasmā avassametaṃ vattabba’’nti.
vsm2.12:90.7: Yathā manussā pakatiyā aniddhimanto kenaci anāvaṭe aparikkhitte asajjamānā gacchanti,
vsm2.12:90.8: evameva so iddhimā cetovasippatto tirokuṭṭaṃ tiropākāraṃ tiropabbataṃ asajjamāno gacchati, seyyathāpi ākāse’’ti (paṭi. ma. 3.11).
vsm2.12:91.1: Sace panassa bhikkhuno adhiṭṭhahitvā gacchantassa antarā pabbato vā rukkho vā uṭṭheti, kiṃ puna samāpajjitvā adhiṭṭhātabbanti?
vsm2.12:91.3: Puna samāpajjitvā adhiṭṭhānaṃ hi upajjhāyassa santike nissayaggahaṇasadisaṃ hoti.
vsm2.12:91.4: Iminā ca pana bhikkhunā ākāso hotūti adhiṭṭhitattā ākāso hotiyeva.
vsm2.12:91.5: Purimādhiṭṭhānabaleneva cassa antarā añño pabbato vā rukkho vā utumayo uṭṭhahissatīti aṭṭhānamevetaṃ.
vsm2.12:91.6: Aññena iddhimatā nimmite pana paṭhamanimmānaṃ balavaṃ hoti.
vsm2.12:91.7: Itarena tassa uddhaṃ vā adho vā gantabbaṃ.
vsm2.12:92.6: ettake ṭhāne pathavī udakaṃ hotūti paricchinditvā parikammaṃ katvā vuttanayeneva adhiṭṭhātabbaṃ.
vsm2.12:92.7: Saha adhiṭṭhānena yathā paricchinne ṭhāne pathavī udakameva hoti.
